g.text: THE CIVILIZATION BENEATH THE DYING SUN
ARCHIVE REF: VAY-8840 // VISUAL DEVELOPMENT PORTFOLIO
CANVAS 01 // SECTOR: THE VERTICAL CHASM // CORE SOLAR-HARVEST CITADEL
MONUMENTAL CHASM CITADEL UNDER THE ECLIPSED DYING SUN
DEFENDERS OF THE SOLAR SPIRES & LIGHT RESERVES
MONOLITHIC HOUSING, SUSPENDED BRIDGES, CRYSTAL CHAMBER
SIGIL OF THE HIGH SUN-KEEPERS OF VAYRATH
The split disc symbolizes the eternal twilight: upper hemisphere golden with captured solar light, lower hemisphere obsidian representing the eternal chasm.
Calculates the 412-day solar cycle. When Sol-Null reaches Zenith, the spires open to charge city-wide crystal batteries.
"VAYR-KOR ZHEL-ATH" — (LIGHT IS MEMORY PRESERVED IN STONE)
TACTILE STRATA OF THE VAYRATHI BIOME
// THE LITANY OF ASH AND GOLD:
"Light is memory. When the celestial fire dimmed, we carved our lives into the deep basalt.
We do not mourn the sun; we drink its last breath into crystal bone."
ORIGINAL WORLD-BUILDING CONCEPT ART SUBMISSION // VAYRATH: THE CIVILIZATION BENEATH THE DYING SUN
RESOLUTION: 2400 × 1600 PX // EDITABLE SVG MASTER // SCALE 1:1
